title: AI Command Center
subtitle: Decisions, risks, forecasts, and next-best actions grounded in live operational context.
accessDenied: You do not have permission to view the AI Workspace.
commandNote: KPIs use executive signals and summary cards. Sparklines are directional context, not audited forecasts.
signalFeedSubtitle: Rule-based L2 insights with source links — never silent automation.
explainRuleBased: Why: derived from permission-filtered executive L2 rules on live records. Not a generative forecast.
briefSubtitle: Evidence-linked digest across twelve operational themes. Summarizes only — never auto-executes.
briefExecSummaryBody: Scan critical alerts, money movement, investor follow-ups, project delays, and recommended priorities. Each theme links to source workspaces.

changed.title: What changed since yesterday
changed.body: Attention and portfolio signals that moved recently.

decisions.title: What requires a decision
decisions.body: Approvals and critical items waiting on leadership.

overdue.title: What is overdue
overdue.body: Aged attention items past expected action windows.

atRisk.title: What is at risk
atRisk.body: Risk and warning signals across delivery and capital.

moneyIn.title: What money is expected

moneyOut.title: What money must be paid
moneyOut.body: Payables and obligations — open Finance for verified figures.

projectDelay.title: Which projects may be delayed
projectDelay.body: Project health and schedule risk signals.

campaigns.title: Which campaigns are underperforming
campaigns.body: Marketing performance gaps when Marketing AI is available.

documents.title: Which documents or approvals are missing
documents.body: Knowledge review queue and document gaps.

priorities.title: Recommended priorities for today
priorities.body: Highest-leverage next actions for the operating day.

copilotSubtitle: Cross-workspace Q&A with cited sources and permission-aware answers (TR/EN).
copilotPermissions: Answers respect your role permissions. Placeholders are labeled. Sensitive mutations require Action Center approval.
copilotEmpty: Ask about priorities, pipeline, investors, cash, or project risks.

copilotPrompt.priorities: What should leadership prioritize today across the portfolio?
copilotPrompt.pipeline: Summarize sales pipeline momentum and bottlenecks without inventing metrics.
copilotPrompt.investors: Which investors need follow-up based on available signals?
copilotPrompt.risks: What project and capital risks need attention now?

actionsSubtitle: Next-best actions with explainability and human approval gates for sensitive work.
actionsApprovalBanner: Sensitive actions (email, stage changes, payments, budgets, publish, automations) require explicit human approval before execution.
awaitingApproval: Awaiting human approval — will not execute silently.

nba.followOverdueInvestorWhy: Investor attention signal indicates stalled follow-up.
nba.followOverdueInvestorExplain: Recommended because executive attention linked an investor record past expected contact cadence. Sending email requires approval.
nba.reviewPaymentApprovalWhy: A finance approval item is pending release.
nba.reviewPaymentApprovalExplain: Recommended from executive approvals feed. Approving or releasing payment is a sensitive action.
nba.advanceOpportunityWhy: Pipeline stall detected in CRM signals.
nba.advanceOpportunityExplain: Stage changes affect forecasting; human confirmation required before mutation.
nba.flagProjectDelayWhy: Project attention or risk signal elevated.
nba.flagProjectDelayExplain: Changing dates is sensitive; recommendation only proposes review in Projects workspace.
nba.pauseUnderperformingCampaignWhy: Marketing health or anomaly signal suggests underperformance.
nba.pauseUnderperformingCampaignExplain: Pausing campaigns requires approval — AI will not pause automatically.
nba.reviewDocumentClassificationWhy: Knowledge review queue has items awaiting human confirmation.
nba.reviewDocumentClassificationExplain: Important document updates require human review before applying.

crmSubtitle: Relationship alerts, tasks, and meetings grounded in CRM live data.
investorSubtitle: Portfolio investor posture and follow-up recommendations.
projectSubtitle: Delivery and construction risk signals from project stats.
financeSubtitle: Cash and obligation posture — verified figures live in Finance workspace.
marketingSubtitle: Campaign health when Marketing AI endpoints are available.
recommendationsSubtitle: Explainable next actions — sensitive mutations gated in Action Center.
explainDomain: Why: synthesized from domain stats and attention signals available to your role.
docsSubtitle: Analysis and classification with mandatory human review for important updates.
docsHumanReview: AI never auto-applies important document updates. Request human review first.
meetingsSubtitle: Preparation briefs and draft notes — never auto-sent.
meetingsNoAutoSend: Meeting notes and emails are never auto-sent. Drafts stay local until a human sends.
forecastSubtitle: Directional ranges with confidence bands — no fake precision.
forecastHonesty: Bands show low–mid–high ranges from available signals. Values are indicative, not audited forecasts.
riskSubtitle: Actionable risks with mitigation links — not decorative badges.
riskEmpty: No elevated risks in current executive signals.
explainRisk: Why: elevated from executive risk or critical attention items on live records.
searchSubtitle: Natural-language search across workspaces and knowledge when providers allow.
searchEmpty: No results yet — try another query or open Executive.
promptsSubtitle: Reusable prompts with local favorites audit trail in this browser.
activitySubtitle: Recent AI sessions for this user in this browser.
activityLocalNote: Activity is stored locally until a platform AI audit API is connected. Favorites and prompts are audited in-browser.
settingsSubtitle: Preferences only — API secrets are never shown or stored here.
settingsNoSecrets: Provider API keys are managed in secure server configuration. This screen never displays secrets.
settingsReadOnly: You can view settings but cannot change them.
allowExternal: Allow external providers for non-confidential context
shareOrgContext: Share organization context with AI prompts
providersSubtitle: Truthful operational states — never fake green when disconnected.
modelMarketingNote: Marketing copilot endpoint responded; still subject to data permissions.
modelLocalNote: Falling back to local heuristic and executive L2 — conversational depth limited.
modelUnavailableNote: No AI provider is currently operational for this session.
localHeuristicDetail: Always-on platform fallback — labeled, never invents verified metrics.
executiveL2Detail: Rule-based priorities, risks, and opportunities from executive APIs.
marketingCopilotDetail: Conversational answers when Marketing AI is healthy.
documentAiDetail: Document intelligence provider from Knowledge Hub status.
vectorSearchDetail: Semantic search availability from Knowledge Hub.
ocrDetail: OCR pipeline status from Knowledge Hub.
indexingDetail: Indexing pipeline status from Knowledge Hub.
approvalBody: This recommendation touches a sensitive action. Confirm you understand it will not run silently.
approvalAck: I approve recording this decision for human execution.
toastReviewRequested: Human review requested — no automatic update applied.
toastApprovalRecorded: Approval recorded. Sensitive action still requires human execution in the source workspace.
